author: blu
body: A TLV is described, not copied. tlv-off is where the CONTENT starts; tlv-hdr is where the tag byte was, so the bytes a signature covers run from tlv-hdr to tlv-off + tlv-len.

author: blu
body: One TLV at an offset. Every failure path returns None. There is no partial success and no "probably fine".

author: blu
body: The high-tag-number form (low five bits all set) is refused here, before anything else looks at it.

author: blu
body: asn1-end is where the next sibling begins.
